::: {.poem}
[So Be Kind]{.poem-title}

Some stop wearing their favorite clothes.\
Some stop clicking pictures.\
Some who once loved to travel, lock themselves in a dark room.\
Some who once made everyone feel alive, now stay quiet.\
Some who only wanted to be loved end up living in complete solitude.\
Everyone commits suicide in a different way.\
The weaker ones may die once, but some die more than once every minute.\
So be kind !

[— words borrowed and reshaped]{.poem-signoff}
:::
